method.identity: primary binary SHA256 plus current IDA function start RVA
method.touched: Hash-verified named function bodies or code ranges resolved to their current IDA owner; may be partial/context only
method.complete: Unique touched owners with full paginated disassembly and complete positive CFG, each block covered by hash-verified primary code ranges
method.provenance: Existing tracked inventory reports only; linked private JSON checked against recorded hashes; no directory-wide raw dump counted
not_measured: Semantic understanding of every listed function
